title: "OOPS!": Out-Of-Band Remote Power Side-Channel Attacks on Intel SGX and TDX
problem: Intel's filtering defense in MSR_IA32_MISC_PACKAGE_CTLS protects against in-band power side-channels but leaves out-of-band (OOB) management interfaces exposed, allowing energy-based attacks on confidential computing enclaves.
motivation: Confidential computing (SGX, TDX) is critical for secure workloads, but current defenses focus only on in-band channels; comprehensive security evaluation must consider integrated attack vectors combining in-band and out-of-band capabilities.
method: The attackers reverse-engineer out-of-band management interfaces—administrative channels built into Intel processors that operate separately from normal CPU operations—to access power consumption readings from the Package Configuration Space, a protected area that Intel's MSR filter doesn't defend. They deliberately disable certain CPU monitoring controls to synchronize when code executes inside a secure enclave (SGX or TDX) with simultaneous out-of-band power measurements. Since different operations consume varying amounts of power, analyzing these patterns reveals what the enclave is executing, enabling secret extraction that the existing in-band protections are designed to prevent.
key_novelty: This is the first demonstration that out-of-band management interfaces built into Intel processors can be exploited to conduct power side-channel attacks on confidential computing platforms like SGX and TDX, bypassing existing in-band defenses.
contributions: Recovery of 2048-bit RSA keys from SGX MbedTLS with single-step assumption
AESNI key extraction from TDX without single-step assumption
Reverse engineering of OOB protocol for PCS access
Demonstrates importance of evaluating both in-band and out-of-band interfaces for confidential computing security

metrics.other: RSA-2048 key recovery success, AESNI key leakage

limitations: Attacks assume access to out-of-band management interface; applicability to systems without OOB exposure is limited.
primary_theme: Out-of-band power side-channel attacks on confidential computing
